notebooks.title: Background mathematics
notebooks.description: Review the mathematical building blocks used throughout the book, including linear functions, vectors, and matrices.

notebooks.title: Supervised learning
notebooks.description: Explore linear regression, adjust its parameters, and visualize the supervised learning loss surface.

notebooks.title: Shallow networks I
notebooks.description: Construct a shallow network with one input and visualize how its hidden units combine into an output function.

notebooks.title: Shallow networks II
notebooks.description: Extend shallow networks to two input dimensions and examine their output surfaces and multiple outputs.

notebooks.title: Shallow network regions
notebooks.description: Calculate the maximum number of linear regions produced by shallow networks as input dimension and width change.

notebooks.title: Activation functions
notebooks.description: Compare activation functions and observe how each changes the functions a shallow network can represent.

notebooks.title: Composing networks
notebooks.description: Feed one neural network into another and visualize how composing networks changes the resulting function.

notebooks.title: Clipping functions
notebooks.description: Examine how hidden layers clip and recombine intermediate functions to create more complex outputs.

notebooks.title: Deep networks
notebooks.description: Express neural networks with matrices and implement forward propagation through multiple hidden layers.

notebooks.title: Least squares loss
notebooks.description: Connect least squares regression to Gaussian likelihood and negative log likelihood.

notebooks.title: Binary cross-entropy loss
notebooks.description: Derive binary classification probabilities and cross-entropy loss from a Bernoulli likelihood.

notebooks.title: Multiclass cross-entropy loss
notebooks.description: Use softmax outputs and a categorical likelihood to compute multiclass cross-entropy loss.

notebooks.title: Line search
notebooks.description: Implement a line search procedure to find the minimum of a one-dimensional function.

notebooks.title: Gradient descent
notebooks.description: Implement gradient descent and visualize its path across a loss surface.

notebooks.title: Stochastic gradient descent
notebooks.description: Compare gradient descent with stochastic updates and examine their optimization trajectories.

notebooks.title: Momentum
notebooks.description: Investigate how momentum changes optimization updates and movement across a loss surface.

notebooks.title: Adam
notebooks.description: Implement Adam and study its adaptive, momentum-based parameter updates.

notebooks.title: Backpropagation in toy model
notebooks.description: Compute derivatives of a toy composite function to understand the steps behind backpropagation.

notebooks.title: Backpropagation
notebooks.description: Implement forward and backward passes to compute gradients in a deep neural network.

notebooks.title: Initialization
notebooks.description: Measure how weight initialization affects activation magnitudes and backpropagated gradients.

notebooks.title: MNIST-1D performance
notebooks.description: Train a simple neural network on MNIST-1D and inspect its classification performance.

notebooks.title: Bias-variance trade-off
notebooks.description: Separate bias and variance in a toy regression model and explore their trade-off.

notebooks.title: Double descent
notebooks.description: Investigate double descent by varying model capacity on MNIST-1D.

notebooks.title: High-dimensional spaces
notebooks.description: Explore geometric and probabilistic properties that behave unexpectedly in high-dimensional spaces.

notebooks.title: L2 regularization
notebooks.description: Add an L2 penalty to a Gabor regression model and examine its effect on the fitted solution.

notebooks.title: Implicit regularization
notebooks.description: Explore the implicit regularization introduced by finite gradient descent step sizes.

notebooks.title: Ensembling
notebooks.description: Combine predictions from multiple models and measure how ensembling changes prediction error.

notebooks.title: Bayesian approach
notebooks.description: Explore Bayesian model fitting and predictions that account for parameter uncertainty.

notebooks.title: Augmentation
notebooks.description: Apply data augmentation to MNIST-1D and investigate its effect on generalization.

notebooks.title: 1D convolution
notebooks.description: Implement one-dimensional convolution and inspect how convolutional layers transform signals.

notebooks.title: Convolution for MNIST-1D
notebooks.description: Build and evaluate a one-dimensional convolutional classifier for MNIST-1D.

notebooks.title: 2D convolution
notebooks.description: Hand-code two-dimensional convolution and compare the operation with PyTorch.

notebooks.title: Downsampling & upsampling
notebooks.description: Explore methods for reducing and increasing the spatial resolution of feature maps.

notebooks.title: Convolution for MNIST
notebooks.description: Train a PyTorch convolutional network to classify handwritten digits in MNIST images.

notebooks.title: Shattered gradients
notebooks.description: Study how gradients change and lose correlation as neural networks become deeper.

notebooks.title: Residual networks
notebooks.description: Add residual connections to MNIST-1D networks and investigate their behavior.

notebooks.title: Batch normalization
notebooks.description: Investigate batch normalization within residual networks.

notebooks.title: Self-attention
notebooks.description: Build a self-attention mechanism from scratch using queries, keys, values, and attention weights.

notebooks.title: Multi-head self-attention
notebooks.description: Construct multi-head self-attention and combine the results of multiple attention heads.

notebooks.title: Tokenization
notebooks.description: Build tokens from text and investigate the tokenization process used by language models.

notebooks.title: Decoding strategies
notebooks.description: Generate text with GPT-2 using sampling, greedy selection, top-k sampling, nucleus sampling, and beam search.

notebooks.title: Encoding graphs
notebooks.description: Represent graph connectivity and node information with matrices.

notebooks.title: Graph classification
notebooks.description: Build a graph network that maps molecular structures of different sizes to a binary output.

notebooks.title: Neighborhood sampling
notebooks.description: Explore neighborhood sampling as a way to process graphs without aggregating every neighbor.

notebooks.title: Graph attention
notebooks.description: Implement graph attention from scratch to weight messages from neighboring nodes.

notebooks.title: GAN toy example
notebooks.description: Explore a toy generative adversarial network and the interaction between its generator and discriminator.

notebooks.title: Wasserstein distance
notebooks.description: Compute Wasserstein distance through an optimal transport linear program and compare distribution divergences.

notebooks.title: 1D normalizing flows
notebooks.description: Transform one-dimensional probability distributions with invertible normalizing flows.

notebooks.title: Autoregressive flows
notebooks.description: Implement an autoregressive flow, its inverse, and a check that the transformation is invertible.

notebooks.title: Contraction mappings
notebooks.description: Use fixed-point iteration with contraction mappings and invert a residual transformation.

notebooks.title: Latent variable models
notebooks.description: Explore a nonlinear latent variable model and how hidden variables generate observed data.

notebooks.title: Reparameterization trick
notebooks.description: Investigate the reparameterization trick for computing gradients through random samples.

notebooks.title: Importance sampling
notebooks.description: Estimate quantities using importance sampling and examine the role of proposal distributions.

notebooks.title: Diffusion encoder
notebooks.description: Implement a diffusion encoder and visualize the gradual corruption of data with noise.

notebooks.title: 1D diffusion model
notebooks.description: Build a one-dimensional diffusion model and sample data through its learned reverse process.

notebooks.title: Reparameterized model
notebooks.description: Reparameterize a diffusion model to predict noise and generate samples through reverse diffusion.

notebooks.title: Families of diffusion models
notebooks.description: Explore families of diffusion sampling processes inspired by denoising diffusion implicit models.

notebooks.title: Markov decision processes
notebooks.description: Simulate Markov processes, rewards, actions, and discounted returns in a gridworld.

notebooks.title: Dynamic programming
notebooks.description: Use dynamic programming for tabular reinforcement learning in a gridworld.

notebooks.title: Monte-Carlo methods
notebooks.description: Estimate values and improve a tabular reinforcement learning policy using Monte Carlo episodes.

notebooks.title: Temporal difference methods
notebooks.description: Apply temporal difference methods to learn from transitions in the penguin gridworld.

notebooks.title: Control variates
notebooks.description: Use correlated control variates to reduce the variance of Monte Carlo estimates.

notebooks.title: Random data
notebooks.description: Investigate neural network training on random data and its implications for memorization.

notebooks.title: Full-batch gradient descent
notebooks.description: Train a network with full-batch gradient descent and examine its learning behavior.

notebooks.title: Lottery tickets
notebooks.description: Prune and retrain neural networks to investigate sparse subnetworks and the lottery ticket phenomenon.

notebooks.title: Adversarial attacks
notebooks.description: Construct fast gradient sign adversarial examples against an MNIST convolutional classifier.

notebooks.title: Bias mitigation
notebooks.description: Explore post-processing methods for mitigating bias in a simulated loan decision system.

notebooks.title: Explainability
notebooks.description: Use LIME-style local explanations to interpret a simulated black-box credit scoring model.
